## The test

**VOID** after 27 pairs. GSPRT, H0: p0 = 0.500, H1: p1 = 0.600, burn-in 20, maximum 500, missing cap 250 per mil. Bounds -2.944 and 2.944, in natural log units (a log-likelihood ratio). Consumed pairs worse / equal / better: 14 / 7 / 6; missing pairs over all 500: 82.
